items.html: Good armour, food and weapons for multiple combat styles as Zenevivia may use protection prayers. In order to save inventory space, the use of Necromancy or hybrid armour may be recommended for mid-to-high-level players. Alternatively, the use of power armour, tank armour, or items that boost life points in order to increase a player's damage/defence is recommendable.

In order to save inventory space, the use of Necromancy or hybrid armour may be recommended for mid-to-high-level players. Alternatively, the use of power armour, tank armour, or items that boost life points in order to increase a player's damage/defence is recommendable.

items.html: For this quest, prioritise the use of combat styles and equipment which specialise in long-ranged attack capabilities, or the ability to damage an opponent from a distance. Players may find use of the Ranged combat style to be exceptionally helpful if not using Necromancy. In addition to the use of Ranged equipment, a Halberd-type weapon may be useful for a Melee style switch -- preferably a Noxious scythe, Attuned crystal halberd, Crystal halberd, or a Dragon halberd. Alternatively, players may also use the Magic combat style, but possibly to a lesser degree of effectiveness than the methods stated above.

alternatives: During your fights, you will not be allowed to summon a familiar, as the Wise Old Man will be following you.

options.text: Can you tell me what's wrong?

substeps.html: As you arrive, go north once and push the one hay bale there all the way to the western wall.
substeps.text: As you arrive, go north once and push the one hay bale there all the way to the western wall.

substeps.html: Standing where you are, push a pair of hay bales at your immediate south twice.
substeps.text: Standing where you are, push a pair of hay bales at your immediate south twice.

substeps.html: Go one square east and push another pair of hay bales to the south.
substeps.text: Go one square east and push another pair of hay bales to the south.

substeps.html: Push the single hay bale directly west of you.
substeps.text: Push the single hay bale directly west of you.

substeps.html: Finally, push the two hay bales to the south of you to clear the path.
substeps.text: Finally, push the two hay bales to the south of you to clear the path.

blocks.text: Talk to Zenevivia.

options.text: What's happened to Mabel?
Are you going to give Mabel her ring?
What do you want me to do?
Okay, off I go.

blocks.html: Search any hay bale for a twig, give it to her.
blocks.text: Search any hay bale for a twig, give it to her.

blocks.html: Talk to her again.
blocks.text: Talk to her again.

options.text: Will you return Mabel's ring and leave now?
I'm trying to complete this quest.
Alright, I'll accept. I'll make you regret this!

blocks.html: Go to Draynor Village and talk to the Wise Old Man.
blocks.text: Go to Draynor Village and talk to the Wise Old Man.

options.text: A woman called Zenevivia wishes to challenge us.

substeps.html: This option may not show up unless the quest Garden of Tranquillity is completed if you started it.
substeps.text: This option may not show up unless the quest Garden of Tranquillity is completed if you started it.

options.text: No.
Yes, let's go.

blocks.html: Head to the Rimmington house portal, talk to him again. (Teleport to Port Sarim and head west.)
blocks.text: Head to the Rimmington house portal, talk to him again. (Teleport to Port Sarim and head west.)

options.text: [Any option]
How can we get in there?

blocks.html: When he leaves, walk to the north-eastern house in Rimmington and talk to him once more.
blocks.text: When he leaves, walk to the north-eastern house in Rimmington and talk to him once more.

options.text: Yes, I'm ready.

options.text: Traps? Very dangerous. You go first.

blocks.text: After the cutscene, continue dialogue with the Wise Old Man.

options.text: What are we going to build?

blocks.html: Craft via on the Clockmaker's bench in the workshop room.
blocks.text: Craft via on the Clockmaker's bench in the workshop room.

options.text: Yes.

blocks.html: Use the bench again to create a dummy.
blocks.text: Use the bench again to create a dummy.

options.text: Okay, I'll get on with it.

blocks.html: Enter the dungeon. During this part, there will be a pulsating purple light around your screen. Any players sensitive to flashing lights should proceed with caution. In addition, you will not be able to control the camera movement, making navigation difficult when windows (such as action bars) are there. Remove the windows or minimise their size.

blocks.html: Traverse through the dungeon, deactivating all the traps by walking on them and then return to the surface.

options.text: Yes, get it out now.

options.text: Yes, I'm sure I found them all. Let's enter.

blocks.html: Traverse through the dungeon, killing all the enemies (high-level players need not worry about using super antifire for the iron dragon as it is fairly weak and may be killed quickly).

options.text: [Any option]
She's insane; let's kill her and leave!
Okay, let's go and face her.

blocks.html: Climb the stairs.
blocks.text: Climb the stairs.

blocks.html: Talk to Zenevivia to start the battle. If you fail your first attempts, return to the Wise Old Man at the house in Rimmington. Right click on the house teleport tabs to modify them for another teleport to the fight.

substeps.text: Zenevivia uses magic spells and flames on the floor that can quickly deal around 600 damage.

items.html: Adventurers who have completed the quest may wish to travel to Keldagrim to talk to a dwarf called Runvastr, who lives on Keldagrim's east side in the house directly south of the pickaxe shop. If you deliver his diary to the Wise Old Man back in Draynor Village, you’ll earn the ability to chip House teletabs to take you to Trollheim as well.
